section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the affect regulation model of positive body image, discussing concepts like body image flexibility and body appreciation. The present study, referred to as 'the current preliminary investigation', aims to extend this model by examining body image flexibility as a mediator between body dissatisfaction and body appreciation. The study focuses on a pre-college sample of White older adolescent females, and a secondary aim is to operationalize body dissatisfaction using broader body size comparison referents.
